record.title: Diagnose recorder termination with a host-only loopback control
record.intent: Require graceful recorder exit and preserved packet-drop statistics before further physical acquisition.
requirements: Commit admitted tasking before execution. Use only a host loopback interface and locally owned test sockets; do not capture or send on the specimen interface or change host network/security policy.
Inspect inherited process signal state and reproduce the smallest relevant failure where necessary. Preserve negative evidence; make fixes only to owned recorder launch and supervision code.
Validate known local payloads, graceful recorder termination, complete capture records, and final packet/drop statistics through the same privileged launch path used at the bench.
Preserve reproducible source, private run evidence and hashes. Require a successful repeated control before proposing any further physical acquisition.
acceptance: A corrected owned-process launch path repeatedly exits gracefully with known payloads and preserved drop statistics
or a concrete blocker is reported.
